bullets: US futures jump (S&P +0.7%, Nasdaq +0.6%) in a shortened Black Friday session as the AI trade rebounds and chip stocks recover.
Asia and Europe both rallied overnight (DAX +2.1%, FTSE +1.8%, MSCI Asia +0.6%), extending Thursday's global bounce in risk assets.
Brent crude rose above $96 after Houthi strikes hit a Saudi refinery, adding a geopolitical risk premium amid Iran-related tensions near Hormuz.
VIX fell 5.3% to 26.8 and the 10Y yield eased to 4.85%, easing stress after one of the market's worst weeks in years.

WST.why: Dropped 7.7% despite a Q3 beat and raised FY guidance; no analyst downgrades, rvol modest (1.47x). Looks like profit-taking/valuation reset after a big prior rally, not identifiable company damage.
WST.bull: Q3 beat, raised FY guidance, strong GLP-1/biologics demand support fundamentals.
WST.bear: Valuation remains stretched after a big rally; drop may be further de-rating, not a bounce setup.

BJ.why: Fell 8.3% even after beating Q3 estimates and raising guidance; a one-time $240M legal settlement funded promos that masked margin pressure. Analysts split: BofA/Morgan Stanley cut, DA Davidson/TD Cowen raised targets.
BJ.bull: Comps +13.5%, membership income +9.5%, FY guidance raised despite one-time items.
BJ.bear: One-time legal settlement inflated profit and funded promos, masking underlying margin erosion.

TXN.why: Down 7.6% in a broad semis selloff after rival Analog Devices' weak outlook hit the whole analog-chip group; no TXN-specific bad news. Cantor Fitzgerald raised its PT to $385 on Nov 23.
TXN.bull: Sector-wide selloff, not TXN-specific; Cantor upgraded PT to $385, shares already rebounding.
TXN.bear: Chip-sector demand/pricing worries from Analog Devices' guidance could persist and cap the bounce.

ASH.why: Fell 7.6% on below-average volume (rvol 0.99), mirroring the market-wide selloff rather than company news. Clariant/CD&R are in advanced buyout talks near the current price, offering downside support if finalized.
ASH.bull: Clariant/CD&R buyout talks offer price support and takeover-premium upside.
ASH.bear: Deal reportedly values Ashland near current price, leaving little premium if talks collapse.
ASH.catalysts: possible Clariant/CD&R buyout announcement or completion

J.why: Down 7.5% (rvol 2.1x) purely on an AI-theme market selloff on Nov 25; no company-specific negative news. Jacobs posted a Q4 beat with backlog growth and four analysts raised price targets this week.
J.bull: Drop tied to AI-theme selloff, not Jacobs; Q4 beat, backlog growth, four PT hikes.
J.bear: Elevated rvol (2.07x) and reliance on AI-capex demand could still slow, pressuring the bounce.

MPC.why: Fell 7.4% as Energy led sector declines (-11%); Citi and Mizuho cut PT citing industrywide refining crack-spread compression, not MPC-specific damage. Q3 crack spreads were still strong at $45.70/bbl.
MPC.bull: Oil/Energy sector-wide pullback, not MPC-specific; Q3 crack spreads strong at $45.70/bbl.
MPC.bear: Citi slashed PT from $518 to $415 on crack-spread compression risk that could persist.
